attempts.text:
**The window opens on a spine.** Columns 0 to 7, `degS` to `sspB`, are carried by 96 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls. The model names 98 to 100% of them, fewest at column 6, `sspA`, 98%.

**A single variable column breaks the first spine**: column 8, `dcuC`, shell, carried by 83%. Then the `nan` genes, columns 9 to 14, [[n-acetylneuraminate catabolism]], carried by 95 to 96%. At column 15, `yhcG`, a fork column carried by 58%, the most plastic stretch of the window, 35% in a region of plasticity.

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 97 against 94%, and hesitates less there, 0.07 against 0.27 bits. It hesitates most at column 15, `yhcG`, a fork column, 0.89 bits.

**The window ends on fork and variable columns.** Columns 75 to 79, `yhbO` to `diaA`, are carried by 52 to 66% of chromosomes, all persistent. The last column is `diaA`, in 52% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 97% of genes**, 0.09 bits on average, perplexity 1.2 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.10 against 0.06 bits, and names fewer genes, 57% against 98%.

label: degS
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the degS window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor degS, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 476 to 555 from dnaA. Read in 539 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying degS once); 43,120 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 97% of genes, 0.09 bits on average (perplexity 1.2 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 40,385 calls, named 99%, 0.04 bits; shell 2,610 calls, named 72%, 0.80 bits; cloud 125 calls, named 41%, 2.74 bits. Outside an RGP 41,788 calls, named 98%, 0.06 bits; inside an RGP 1,332 calls, named 57%, 1.10 bits. Columns: 72 spine, 2 fork, 6 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.10 against 0.06 bits) and names fewer genes (57% against 98%); 1,332 of the 43,120 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 15 (yhcG, a fork column) 0.89 bits, RGP 35%; column 16 (gltD, a spine column) 0.46 bits, RGP 35%; column 55 (yhbX, a variable column) 0.42 bits, RGP 0.2%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 72 spine columns: named 97%, 0.07 bits on average; the 8 fork and variable columns: named 94%, 0.27 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 15, is a fork column.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: column 15 (fork), RGP 35%; the least: columns 0-7 (spine), RGP 0%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-7 (8 columns) spine: share 96-100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: degS "outer membrane-stress sensor serine…", degQ, zapG, zapE "cell division protein ZapE", rplM, rpsI, sspA, sspB "ClpXP protease specificity-enhancin…". named 98-100% (mean 99%), fewest named at column 6 (sspA), named 98%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.13 bits (column 6 (sspA)).
[S2] 2. column 8 variable: share 83%, all S, RGP 0.4%. named 95%; 0.36 bits.
[S2.c8]    8: dcuC S 83%
[S3] 3. columns 9-14 (6 columns) spine: share 95-96%, all P, RGP 0.2-2%. Genes: nanR, nanA "N-acetylneuraminate lyase", nanT, nanE, nanK, nanQ. named 95-99.8% (mean 98%), fewest named at column 14 (nanQ), named 95%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.19 bits (column 9 (nanR)).
[S4] 4. column 15 fork: share 58%, all S, RGP 35%. named 80%; 0.89 bits.
[S4.c15]    15: yhcG S 58% "PDDEXK nuclease domain-containing p…"; also "transposase" S 17%, "IS1 family transposase" S 17%
[S5] 5. columns 16-54 (39 columns) spine: share 95-96%, all P, RGP 0-35%. Genes: gltD "glutamate synthase subunit GltD", gltB, yhcC "TIGR01212 family radical SAM protein", arcB, elbB, mtgA, yrbL "PhoP regulatory network protein YrbL", npr, rapZ, ptsN, hpf, rpoN, lptB "LPS export ABC transporter ATP-bind…", lptA, lptC, kdsC, kdsD "arabinose-5-phosphate isomerase KdsD", yrbG "calcium/sodium antiporter", mlaF, mlaE "lipid asymmetry maintenance ABC tra…", mlaD, mlaC, mlaB, ibaG, murA, sfsB, ispB, rplU, rpmA, yhbE "DMT family transporter", cgtA, dacB, greA, yhbY "ribosome assembly RNA-binding prote…", rlmE, ftsH, folP, glmM, secG. named 65-99% (mean 97%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 16 (gltD), named 65%, 0.46 bits.
[S6] 6. column 55 variable: share 86%, all S, RGP 0.2%. named 93%; 0.42 bits.
[S6.c55]    55: yhbX S 86% "phosphoethanolamine transferase"
[S7] 7. columns 56-74 (19 columns) spine: share 92-96%, all P, RGP 0.2-1%. Genes: argG, rimP, nusA, infB, rbfA, truB, rpsO, pnp, nlpI, yrbN "protein YrbN", deaD, mtr, yhbW "luciferase-like monooxygenase", ubiV, ubiU, ubiT "ubiquinone anaerobic biosynthesis a…", yhbS "GNAT family N-acetyltransferase", yhbQ "DNA damage response exodeoxyribonuc…", yhbP "YhbP family protein". named 96-98% (mean 98%), fewest named at column 68 (yhbW), named 96%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.13 bits (column 56 (argG)).
[S8] 8. columns 75-79 (5 columns) fork and variable columns: share 52-66%, all P, RGP 1-3%. named 96-98% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 78, named 96%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.11 bits (column 79).
[S8.c75]    75 variable: yhbO P 66% "protein/nucleic acid deglycase"
[S8.c76]    76 variable: yraR P 62% "NAD(P)H-binding protein"
[S8.c77]    77 variable: yraQ P 60% "permease"
